title: fix(sortBy): read initial index name from parent index
body:
## Description

This fixes a bug where the `sortBy` widget used to read the `indexName` from the InstantSearch instance. It now reads the `indexName` from its parent index.

## Changes

* The index widget now exposes its name with `getIndexName`.
* The test mocks were updated and used to get closer to a real environment. In a real environment, [all widgets receive a `parent` at the `init` step](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/bf0497864d880e41007e80ac163d270fcc3f83a0/src/widgets/index/index.ts#L219). The mock didn't reflect that. It is updated to be assigned the main index coming from the InstantSearch instance by default (this is the default behavior when using InstantSearch without nested indices). The tests for the `index` widget now need to explicitly set the `parent` to `null` (this is fine because this is a rarer case compared to all other widgets).
